17860491_f1ffddb9.text: Treatment with the orexin-1 receptor antagonist SB334867 increased the activity of basolateral amygdala neurons projecting to infralimbic medial prefrontal cortex during fear extinction. GABAergic interneurons expressing calbindin, but not parvalbumin, were also activated by orexin-1 receptor antagonism in the basolateral amygdala.

17860491_748a5fb1.text: Distinct populations of BLA neurons encode fear conditioning and extinction processes (Herry et al., 2008). These cell populations, functionally defined as "fear neurons" and "extinction neurons," overlap with 2 different anatomically defined subtypes of BLA neurons projecting to prelimbic medial prefrontal cortex (PL) or IL, respectively
